definitions: （说法、名称等）听起来的感觉；给人的印象（常用于 have a ... ring to it）

examples.text: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does carry an important extra distinction.
examples.explanation: 这里的 ring 不是“戒指”或“铃声”，而是指一个说法或标签“听起来的感觉”。a much better ring to it 表示“听起来好得多、更顺耳”。
